source_documents.title: MUM-T attack maneuver unstructured test text

source_units.text: Ahead of an attack maneuver in inland hilly terrain, the tank company activated a MUM-T system combining three reconnaissance drones and a lightweight TDSS.
The TDSS confirmed that communication with the battalion server was normal, and after the three drones launched sequentially, the integrated SA screen was displayed on the HMI.

The company commander shared the drone surveillance status and expected enemy positions with the tank commanders of each platoon, and the TDSS made the initial transmission of company SA summary information to the battalion server.
Drone 1 picked up the suspected enemy observation post heat source, and the company commander decided on the right bypass maneuver.
Drone 1 Edge AI detected the possibility of 3-4 FPV drones, and the TDSS displayed the approach speed and estimated time of arrival on the HMI.
When the packet loss rate persisted above the threshold, the TDSS began the transition from normal communication to limited communication mode.
Even in limited communication mode, the TDSS updated minimum SA based on summary track data and performed graceful degradation.
When heartbeat loss persisted for a certain time or more, the TDSS declared the transition from limited mode to communication blackout mode.
When the link was maintained for a certain time or more, the TDSS began the transition from blackout mode to limited mode.
After confirming that bandwidth had recovered and connection stability was maintained, the TDSS began the transition from limited mode to normal communication mode.
During the operation, the key transitions proceeded from normal communication to limited communication, from limited communication to blackout, from blackout to limited, and from limited to normal.

scenarios.label: MUM-T-based attack maneuver and electronic warfare response
scenarios.summary: The tank company performs the attack maneuver using reconnaissance drones and the TDSS, maintains survivability-focused functions even during electronic warfare jamming, and then recovers communication and secures the objective.

episodes.label: Electronic warfare jamming and communication degradation response

episodes.summary: As the intermittent links stabilize, communication recovers from blackout to limited and from limited to normal, and the company resumes the attack on the objective.
